introLi1: Change the icon: upload a PNG/JPG/DDS under "National Spirit Picture" below. It gets named and written back to the Picture field automatically.
introLi2: Change the attributes: fill key/value in the "Modifier" section below (e.g. stability_factor / 0.05), one per line. See the validation hints and the ~2700-entry vanilla modifier dictionary for the full set.
introLi3: Change the text: fill Name (EN/ZH) and Description (EN/ZH). After export they land in .
introOutcome: Launch HOI4 → pick a country → Politics tab → see the custom icon + attributes in effect.
idCollisionTitle: This ID is already taken by idea {name}, so saving will clash. Pick a different ID, or select that idea and edit it instead.
ideaIdTitle: Idea ID · HOI4 internal unique identifier
ideaIdContent: The idea identifier, unique across the whole mod. Lowercase + underscores, no spaces/Chinese. Scripts query it with has_idea = X and reference it in add_idea / remove_idea effects. Naming conventions: great_depression (focus story), military_advisor_1 (advisor), USA_war_plans (country-specific). Renaming breaks all script references + corrupts old saves, so be careful.
typeContent:
Decides which HOI4 group the idea belongs to (the block name in common/ideas/ files):
• National Spirit: a persistent bonus granted at start / by event / by focus
• Hidden: a non-displayed hidden idea, used by scripts (flag-style, modifier container)
• Tank/Ship/Aircraft/Materiel Designer: equipment design companies (can set research_bonus, traits)
• Industrial Concern: industrial firm
Different types allow different fields; Designers have dedicated research_bonus + designer_traits.
pictureContent: The GFX name of the idea icon. **Two ways to fill it**: ① reference a vanilla/existing GFX (type it manually, e.g. usa_great_depression_3, the GFX_idea_ prefix is auto-added); ② upload a custom image (the Upload button below, the program auto-names it GFX_idea_'{'TAG'}'_'{'idea_id'}' and writes back to this field — no manual entry needed). Corresponds to the spriteType name in interface/*.gfx. On export the program only ships a `picture =` line when the asset is real: an uploaded image, or a name that matches a vanilla GFX. A custom name with no uploaded image is omitted (no broken '?' picture in-game).
pictureShipNote: Custom names need an uploaded image (below) or a vanilla GFX reference — otherwise the picture is omitted on export (no broken '?' in-game).
removalCostContent: The PP-cost baseline when the remove_ideas effect removes this idea (at the script level, not a HOI4 decision). **-1 = cannot be removed** (common for permanent national spirits). Vanilla distribution is overwhelmingly -1 (~3400 cases); 10 is rare (37 cases, a near-free-to-remove temporary idea); **mid values (50~200) are almost never seen in vanilla** — mid values are a mod-extension style, not a built-in HOI4 convention. Blank is equivalent to -1.
costContent: The political-power price to activate this idea (vanilla `cost =`). Distinct from removal_cost (which is the price to REMOVE it). 0 = unset → omitted on export, and the engine falls back to its built-in default (150). Most national spirits leave this 0; it matters mainly for swappable/selectable idea slots where activating one costs PP.
modifierContent: A modifier block that applies **continuously** to this country while the idea is active (the opposite of a one-shot effect). It applies when active and disappears when removed — this is the core value of a national spirit. Common stats: political_power_gain (PP accumulation), stability_factor (stability), production_factory_max_efficiency_factor (factory efficiency), consumer_goods_factor (consumer-goods ratio). Use decimals (0.05 = +5%). Multiple can stack.
allowedContent: trigger block controlling whether the idea can be granted. Evaluated once for the player at game start — if unmet the idea doesn't exist in that country's idea list (later add_idea scripts still need this condition). Common vanilla idea: allowed = '{' original_tag = USA '}' gives it only to USA. always = no means this idea **can only be granted via the add_idea script** (not auto-inherited). Difference from allowed_civil_war: the latter is a separate check for whether a civil-war split country inherits it.
allowedCivilWarContent: trigger block for whether this idea is inherited by a civil-war split side. Defaults to always = yes (inherited). Scenarios: vanilla persistent national spirits inherit by default (both sides have it after a split); event/focus temporary ideas usually use allowed_civil_war = '{' always = no '}' (gone after the civil war, the new country re-runs the story). Affects the starting state of new TAGs produced by start_civil_war / release_puppet.
availableContent: trigger block · controls whether the idea can be granted (a one-shot evaluation by player/script). Unmet → the idea doesn't appear. Vanilla examples: has_war = no / has_government = democratic. Empty = no gate.
visibleContent: trigger block · controls whether the idea shows in the politics-panel UI. Unmet = hidden but still in effect (the modifier still applies). To truly remove it, use cancel.
cancelContent: trigger block · when met the engine auto-removes this idea (independent of visible/allowed). Vanilla uses it for things like great_depression that "auto-lift after a focus completes".
allowedToRemoveContent: trigger block · gates the player's UI "spend PP to remove" button. Empty + removal_cost ≥ 0 → the player can pay to remove. Add conditions to lock it = must be met before removal.
doEffectContent: effect block · runs continuously while the idea is active (paired with a limit clause). Used to attach "ongoing script side effects" beyond a pure modifier's scope.
onAddContent: runs once when add_idea fires. Vanilla uses it to log a history event, set a flag, or grant resources.
onRemoveContent: runs once on remove_ideas / auto-cancel. The cleanup counterpart to on_add.
cancelIfInvalidContent: true (vanilla default) · the engine auto-removes it when available turns false. false = kept even if the condition fails.
autoAttachOnStartContent: true (default) · this national spirit is force-added at game start via on_startup add_ideas. add_ideas bypasses the idea's own allowed block, so an endgame/conditional spirit marked allowed always=no would still appear on day 1. Set false to keep it dormant until a focus or event explicitly add_ideas it.
levelContent: 0 = unset (not emitted). Some idea families use level for multi-tier same-effect bands.
ledgerContent: Empty = general/political · civilian/army/navy/air = routed to the matching staff panel.
targetedModifierContent: JSON list · each entry = '{'"tag": "USA", "modifier": '{'"trade_opinion_factor": 0.2'}''}' · each maps to one vanilla targeted_modifier = '{' tag = ... '}' block. AI atom: add_idea_targeted_modifier increments a single value.
equipmentBonusContent: JSON dict · top-level keys MUST be **ARCHETYPES** (infantry_equipment / fighter_equipment / heavy_tank_chassis · 83 vanilla) · **NOT INSTANCEs** (infantry_equipment_1 and other numbered variants). INSTANCEs only belong under add_equipment_production / set_technology. e.g. '{'"infantry_equipment": '{'"soft_attack": 0.1'}', "instant": true'}'. instant=true applies immediately (instead of waiting for the next research to finish). AI atom: update_idea_equipment_bonus increments a single value.
equipmentBonusInstanceWarning: ⚠ "{key}" is an INSTANCE, not an ARCHETYPE · equipment_bonus top-level keys must be ARCHETYPES like "{archetype}" · INSTANCEs only belong under add_equipment_production / set_technology
equipmentBonusUnknownWarning: ⚠ "{key}" is not in the 83 vanilla ARCHETYPEs · likely a typo or a mod-defined archetype · double-check spelling if vanilla
ruleContent: JSON dict · scalar values · e.g. '{'"can_create_factions": true, "can_send_volunteers": false'}'. bool renders as yes/no. AI atom: update_idea_rule single value.
preservedFieldsNote: These fields are preserved from import and will be included in export.
